text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: auto-rollback triggered for release=2.4.7b service=serving-runtime. Canary (eu-west-1) p95 memory +22% vs baseline over 10m. Initiating rollback step=3/5. :rotating_light:
jordan: saw the alert. grabbing logs, anyone oncall in eu-west? :eyes:
maya: i'm oncall, joining now. Will tail logs and traces.
eli: quick context — 2.4.7b includes KV-cache kernel rewrite; could be growth in long-lived sessions.
sasha: FYI support: two customers reported latency errors in eu-west, ticket INC-1247. cc @ben-sales.
maya: tailing logs, sharing snippet:
```
[2026-03-20T10:12:33Z] serving-runtime: pid=1124 mem=1.9GB -> 2.6GB (session=abc123)
[2026-03-20T10:12:34Z] session stream: UA=raven-smoke/1.2 path=/generate
[2026-03-20T10:12:35Z] GC: mark-sweep paused 120ms
```
oncall-bot: canary-halting: traffic shifted back to stable variant (2.4.6) for eu-west-1. ETA rollback completion ~3m.
jordan: pause — looking at traces, majority of high-mem sessions come from UA 'raven-smoke/1.2'. That looks like internal smoke tests, not real traffic. Can we confirm before a full region-wide revert?
maya: confirmed. ~88% of spikes from internal runner IP range 10.20.30.0/24.
eli: recommendation: abort global auto-rollback, perform a targeted rollback only on canary hosts and throttle internal runners. Avoid full-production revert unless necessary.
product-ops: we need comms if we change plan. If we manually override auto-rollback, we'll tell affected customers and ops. Draft suggestion: short blurb to CS + two impacted customers.
ben-sales: on it — looping CS now. I'll draft a brief note and ping legal if needed.
jordan: proposed plan:
1) abort global automatic rollback
2) targeted revert for eu-west canary pool only
3) block internal smoke runner and validate
4) monitor 30m, then unpin or escalate
confirm?
maya: executing targeted rollback now:
```bash
redwoodctl rollout revert --service serving-runtime --version 2.4.7b --targets eu-west-1-canary --reason "mem spike traced to internal smoke" --ticket INC-1247
```
deploy-bot: Revert job submitted. job_id=rbk-2350-01. Est completion 4m.
oncall-bot: rollback completed on targeted hosts. p95 memory back to baseline for canary. No further global action taken. :white_check_mark:
jordan: good catch. Pin stable for prod traffic until postmortem. Setting release pin: 2.4.6 -> duration 24h.
product-ops: will update release notes + incident blurb. Owner: sasha. Action items: short customer comms, internal postmortem, adjust deploy-bot thresholds.
sasha: drafting postmortem outline and comms. Adding items: 1) prevent internal UAs from reaching canary, 2) add UA/ASN filter to canary gating, 3) tweak deploy-bot noise thresholds.
ben-sales: comms draft sent to CS + affected accounts. PR opened in docs for rollback decision matrix.
eli: scheduling retrospective 14:00 UTC tomorrow. Will attach logs, rollout timeline, and INC-1247.
maya: monitoring for another 20m then will close INC-1247. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
